prathamaḥ kāṇḍaḥ

vimalakalāśrayābhinavasṛṣṭimahā jananī bharitatanuś ca pañcamukhaguptarucir janakaḥ /
tadubhayayāmalasphuritabhāvavisargamayaṃ hṛdayam anuttarāmṛtakulaṃ mama saṃsphuratāt // [AgMsv_1.1]
quick_english: May the first section shine, with its divine parents and heart as the family of supreme nectar.

label: AgMsv_1.2
cite_parts:
yadīyabodhakiraṇair ullasadbhiḥ samantataḥ /
vikāsihṛdayāmbhojā vayaṃ sa jayatād guruḥ // [AgMsv_1.2]
quick_english: May that teacher conquer, whose shining rays of knowledge make our hearts blossom everywhere.

label: AgMsv_1.3
cite_parts:
sābhimarśaṣaḍardhārthapañcasrotaḥsamujjvalān /
yaḥ prādān mahyam arthaughān daurgatyadalanavratān // [AgMsv_1.3]
quick_english: He gave me floods of meanings, bright with reflection and streams, that destroy poverty.

label: AgMsv_1.4
cite_parts:
śrīmatsumatisaṃśuddhaḥ sadbhaktajanadakṣiṇaḥ /
śambhunāthaḥ prasanno me bhūyād vākpuṣpatoṣitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.4]
quick_english: May Shambhunatha, pure and skilled toward true devotees, be pleased with me through speech-flowers.

label: AgMsv_1.5
cite_parts:
gurubhyo 'pi garīyāṃsaṃ yuktaṃ śrīcukhalābhidham /
vande yatkṛtasaṃskāraḥ sthito 'smi galitagrahaḥ // [AgMsv_1.5]
quick_english: I salute Shricukhala, greater than teachers, by whose purification I stand freed from grasping.

label: AgMsv_1.6
cite_parts:
tato gurutaraḥ śrīmān bhūtirājo mahāmatiḥ /
jayatād bhaktajanatāsamuddharaṇasāhasaḥ // [AgMsv_1.6]
quick_english: May glorious great-minded Bhutiraja conquer, bolder than the guru in rescuing devotees.

label: AgMsv_1.7
cite_parts:
śrīsomānandasaṃbodhaśrīmadutpalaniḥsṛtāḥ /
jayanti saṃvidāmodasaṃdarbhā dikprasarpiṇaḥ // [AgMsv_1.7]
quick_english: The joyful consciousness compositions arising from Shri Somananda and Utpala conquer, spreading in all directions.

label: AgMsv_1.8
cite_parts:
taddṛṣṭisaṃsṛticchedipratyabhijñopadeśinaḥ /
śrīmallakṣmaṇaguptasya guror vijayate vacaḥ // [AgMsv_1.8]
quick_english: The speech of teacher Shriman Lakshmanagupta conquers, teaching recognition that cuts the world cycle.

label: AgMsv_1.9
cite_parts:
apy asaṃkhyanavāsvādacamatkāraikadurmadā /
yenānuttarasaṃbhogatṛptā me matiṣaṭpadī // [AgMsv_1.9]
quick_english: Even my bee-mind, intoxicated by the wonder of countless new tastes, is satisfied in supreme enjoyment.

label: AgMsv_1.10
cite_parts:
tadekamayatām āpya svātmany eva tathā sthitā /
tad asyāḥ pronmiṣanty eva vividhā nādasaṃpadaḥ // [AgMsv_1.10]
quick_english: Having attained unity with that in one's own self, various sound-riches indeed blossom from it.

label: AgMsv_1.11
cite_parts:
sacchiṣyakarṇamandrābhyām arthito 'haṃ punaḥ punaḥ /
vākyārthaṃ vartaye śrīmanmālinyāṃ yat kva cit kva cit // [AgMsv_1.11]
quick_english: Requested by good disciples' ears, I explain sentence meaning again and again in Shrimanmalini, here and there.

label: AgMsv_1.12
cite_parts:
aucityenetaratyāgād vācyavācakayor mithaḥ /
vartanāvarta etasmin sādhu śāstraṃ ca vārttikam // [AgMsv_1.12]
quick_english: By fitness and abandoning the other, scripture and commentary circulate well in this mutual usage of expressed and expressor.

label: AgMsv_1.13
cite_parts:
ye 'harniśaṃ prakāśante sarvasya ca na gocare /
numo 'bhinavaguptāṃs tāñ śivacandrāṃśusaṃcayān // [AgMsv_1.13]
quick_english: We bow day and night to those Abhinavaguptas, collections of Shiva moon rays, shining beyond all range.

label: AgMsv_1.14
cite_parts:
jayanti jagadānandavipakṣakṣapaṇakṣamāḥ /
parameśamukhodbhūtajñānacandramarīcayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.14]
quick_english: The moon rays of knowledge born from Paramesha's face conquer, able to destroy opponents of world bliss.

label: AgMsv_1.15
cite_parts:
aniyantritasadbhāvād bhāvābhedaikabhāginaḥ /
yat prāg jātaṃ mahājñānaṃ tadraśmibharavaibhavam // [AgMsv_1.15]
quick_english: From unrestrained true being, sharing one nature with beings, great knowledge born before has the glory of its rays.

label: AgMsv_1.16
cite_parts:
tataṃ tādṛk svamāyīyaheyopādeyavarjitam /
vitatībhāvanācitraraśmitāmātrabheditam // [AgMsv_1.16]
quick_english: Spread and such, it is free from maya's rejectable and acceptable, differentiated only by various thought rays.

label: AgMsv_1.17
cite_parts:
abhimarśasvabhāvaṃ tad dhṛdayaṃ parameśituḥ /
tatrāpi śaktyā satataṃ svātmamayyā maheśvaraḥ // [AgMsv_1.17]
quick_english: That heart of the supreme lord has the nature of reflection; even there Maheshvara always acts by power made of his own self.

label: AgMsv_1.18
cite_parts:
yadā saṃghaṭṭam āsādya samāpattiṃ parāṃ vrajet /
tadāsya paramaṃ vaktraṃ visargaprasarāspadam // [AgMsv_1.18]
quick_english: When, having reached contact, he would go to supreme absorption, then his supreme face becomes the seat of emission expansion.

label: AgMsv_1.19
cite_parts:
anuttaravikāsodyajjagadānandasundaram /
bhāvivaktrāvibhāgena bījaṃ sarvasya yat sthitam // [AgMsv_1.19]
quick_english: The seed of all stands, beautiful world bliss rising from supreme expansion, by non-difference of future face.

label: AgMsv_1.20
cite_parts:
hṛtspandadṛkparāsāranirnāmormyādi tan matam /
etat paraṃ trikaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvaśaktyavibhāgavat // [AgMsv_1.20]
quick_english: That opinion, heart pulse vision supreme flow wave etc, is the supreme trika before, undivided from all powers.

label: AgMsv_1.21
cite_parts:
atra bhāvasamullāsaśaṅkāsaṃkocavicyuteḥ /
svānandalīnatāmātramātricchākarmadṛktrayam // [AgMsv_1.21]
quick_english: Here, from release of expansion and contraction doubt, only the three of will, knowledge, and action remain in absorption in own bliss.

label: AgMsv_1.22
cite_parts:
tathā ca guravaḥ śaivadṛṣṭāv itthaṃ nyarūpayan /
sa yad āste cidāhlādamātrānubhavatallayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.22]
quick_english: Thus teachers described it in the Shaiva view: he stands absorbed in experience of consciousness bliss only.

label: AgMsv_1.23
cite_parts:
tad icchā tāvatī jñānaṃ tāvat tāvat kriyā hi sā /
susūkṣmaśaktitritayasāmarasyena vartate // [AgMsv_1.23]
quick_english: That will, so much knowledge, and so much action indeed occur by harmony of three subtle powers.

label: AgMsv_1.24
cite_parts:
cidrūpāhlādaparamas tadābhinno bhaved iti /
nanu cedṛśi viśvātmabhūte saṃkocavarjanāt // [AgMsv_1.24]
quick_english: Supreme in consciousness-form bliss would be undivided from that; but, it is asked, in such a world-self, from abandoning contraction?

label: AgMsv_1.25
cite_parts:
vikalpakalpanāmūlāḥ kathaṃ śāstrādisaṃpadaḥ /
ucyate sarva evāyaṃ bodhaḥ saṃvitprabhāmayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.25]
quick_english: How are scripture and other riches said to be rooted in conceptual construction? All this knowledge is made of consciousness radiance.

label: AgMsv_1.26
cite_parts:
prakāśarūpatāyogāc cidāmarśaghanātmakaḥ /
tatrāmarśasvabhāvo 'yaṃ yaḥ prakāśaḥ prakāśate // [AgMsv_1.26]
quick_english: Because it is of the nature of light, awareness is essentially dense with conscious self-reflection; and that light which shines has reflective awareness as its very nature.

tokens.grounds: compound: prakāśa + rūpatā + yoga; ablative of reason
compound: cit + āmarśa + ghana + ātmaka; describes bodhaḥ/prakāśaḥ

label: AgMsv_1.27
cite_parts:
sa eva kiṃ na śāstraughaḥ kim anyair yuktiḍambaraiḥ /
paravāgdevatāviddhas tatrāsau kevalaṃ bhavet // [AgMsv_1.27]
quick_english: Why should that very light not be the flood of scriptures? What need is there for other displays of reasoning? One who is pierced by the supreme goddess of speech would simply abide in that.

tokens.grounds: compound: para + vāc + devatā + viddha; describes the qualified person

label: AgMsv_1.28
cite_parts:
na tu laukikamāyīyavarṇapuñjavicitritaḥ /
uktaṃ śrīpratyabhijñāyām ātmasaṃsthasya bhāsanam // [AgMsv_1.28]
quick_english: But it is not variegated by masses of ordinary, māyic letters. As it is said in the revered Pratyabhijñā, what abides in the self shines forth of itself.

tokens.grounds: compound: laukika + māyīya + varṇa + puñja + vicitrita; negated description
compound: śrī + pratyabhijñā; locative of source

label: AgMsv_1.29
cite_parts:
asty eva na vinā tasmād icchāmarśaḥ pravartate /
svabhāvam avabhāsasya vimarśaṃ vidur anyathā // [AgMsv_1.29]
quick_english: Reflective awareness of will does indeed proceed and is not absent from that. The wise know reflective awareness to be the very nature of manifestation; otherwise, manifestation would not be what it is.

tokens.grounds: governs tasmād in sense of separation from that

label: AgMsv_1.30
cite_parts:
prakāśo 'rthoparakto 'pi tulyo ratnādikair iti /
kiṃca yaḥ kaś canāmarśaś ciccamatkāragocaraḥ // [AgMsv_1.30]
quick_english: Even if light tinged by an object seems similar to jewels and the like, any reflective awareness at all belongs to the domain of the wonder of consciousness.

tokens.grounds: compound: ratna + ādi; instrumental of comparison

label: AgMsv_1.31
cite_parts:
hlādatāpādiviṣayas tadāsau bhavati sphuṭaḥ /
tadvimarśāntarālambasamucchalanayogataḥ // [AgMsv_1.31]
quick_english: When reflective awareness has joy, pain, and the like as its objects, it becomes clear through the surging inner grasp that arises within that reflection.

tokens.grounds: compound: hlāda + tāpa + ādi + viṣaya; describes āmarśaḥ
compound: tad + vimarśa + antarālamba + samucchalana + yoga; ablative of cause

label: AgMsv_1.32
cite_parts:
paścāt susphuṭatām eti tathā ca gurur ūcivān /
yathā svasaṃvidā siddhaṃ sukhādi vyavatiṣṭhate // [AgMsv_1.32]
quick_english: Afterward it attains full clearness. And so the teacher has said: pleasure and the like are established by one's own awareness and stand firm on that basis.

label: AgMsv_1.33
cite_parts:
na hi vyavasthāsamaye vedyate tat svasaṃvidā /
tathāvaśyopagantavyaṃ svasaṃvitsādhanād iti // [AgMsv_1.33]
quick_english: For at the time of later determination it is not known in that same way by self-awareness; even so, it must necessarily be accepted as established by self-awareness.

tokens.grounds: compound: vyavasthā + samaya; locative of time
compound: svasaṃvit + sādhana; ablative of reason

label: AgMsv_1.34
cite_parts:
evam atrāpi paścād yaj jñānādyullāsavartmani /
sarvābhedamayī bhūmir yāvad āmṛśyatāṃ vrajet // [AgMsv_1.34]
quick_english: So too here: afterward, on the path where knowledge and the other powers rise, the level consisting of universal non-difference comes to be reflectively apprehended.

tokens.grounds: compound: jñāna + ādi + ullāsa + vartman; locative
compound: sarva + abheda + maya; describes bhūmiḥ
correlative with tāvat in next verse

label: AgMsv_1.35
cite_parts:
tāvat taducitodāravimarśāṃśasphuṭatvataḥ /
tādṛk sa eva śāstratvaṃ prāgvisargaḥ prapadyate // [AgMsv_1.35]
quick_english: Then, because a noble reflective portion fitting that level becomes clear, that very primordial emission attains the status of scripture.

tokens.grounds: compound: tad + ucita + udāra + vimarśa + aṃśa + sphuṭatva; ablative of cause

label: AgMsv_1.36
cite_parts:
etad eva tu yuktaṃ syāt tathā hy anupadhau pare /
śāstrārthe 'pi samācāraleśaḥ ko 'pi vibhāvyate // [AgMsv_1.36]
quick_english: This indeed would be fitting, for even in the unconditioned supreme meaning of scripture some trace of practice can be discerned.

label: AgMsv_1.37
cite_parts:
sa nūnaṃ sphuṭatādhāmabhāvijñānādiśaktimān /
uparāgāt tatas tattadvaicitryaparibṛṃhitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.37]
quick_english: That trace surely possesses the powers of knowledge and the rest that will arise in the abode of clearness; and from conditioning it becomes expanded into various manifold distinctions.

tokens.grounds: refers to the trace of practice
compound: sphuṭatā + dhāman + bhāvin + jñāna + ādi + śaktimat

label: AgMsv_1.38
cite_parts:
yathā mukhasya tadvyaktisthāne 'psu mukure maṇau /
khaḍge cañcalasadvṛttasūkṣmadīrghādikā sthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.38]
quick_english: Just as a face appears in water, a mirror, a jewel, or a sword as trembling, round, subtle, long, and so on, so its manifestation varies with the medium.

tokens.grounds: elided apsu; locative plural used for medium
compound: cañcala + sadvṛtta + sūkṣma + dīrgha + ādi; describes sthitiḥ

label: AgMsv_1.39
cite_parts:
tad itthaṃ parame rūpe prodbhūtā jñānasaṃpadaḥ /
anavacchinnahṛdayabījātmatrayasundarāḥ // [AgMsv_1.39]
quick_english: Thus, in the supreme form, the treasures of knowledge arise, beautiful with the unlimited triad of heart, seed, and self.

tokens.grounds: compound: anavacchinna + hṛdaya + bīja + ātman + traya + sundara

label: AgMsv_1.40
cite_parts:
yadā tūcchaladākārasvataraṅgāntarātmakān /
visisṛkṣati bhāvaughān bhairavaḥ śaktibṛṃhitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.40]
quick_english: But when Bhairava, expanded by power, desires to emit the floods of beings as inner waves of his own surging form,

tokens.grounds: tu + ucchalat + ākāra + sva + taraṅga + antar + ātmaka; describes bhāvaughān

label: AgMsv_1.41
cite_parts:
tadā tā eva vijñānasaṃpadas tadupādhijām /
īṣatkriyāsamācārayantraṇāṃ saṃśritā iva // [AgMsv_1.41]
quick_english: Then those very treasures of cognition, as if taking on a constraint of slight activity and practice born from that limiting condition,

tokens.grounds: compound: tad + upādhi + ja; describes īṣatkriyāsamācārayantraṇām
compound: īṣat + kriyā + samācāra + yantraṇā; object of saṃśritāḥ

label: AgMsv_1.42
cite_parts:
paritas tattaraṅgaughasātmatāṃ samupāśrite /
tathāpi jagadānandasundare bodhabhairave // [AgMsv_1.42]
quick_english: having assumed all around an identity with the flood of those waves, still remain within awareness-Bhairava, who is beautiful with the bliss of the world.

tokens.grounds: compound: tad + taraṅga + ogha + sātmatā; object of samupāśrite
locative absolute participle contextually; describes the state
compound: jagat + ānanda + sundara; locative describing bodhabhairave

label: AgMsv_1.43
cite_parts:
bhāvanirbharatāmātrasaṃtṛpte śaktiśālini /
pūrṇayā nijaśaktyaiva nyakkṛte śaktimatpade // [AgMsv_1.43]
quick_english: In that powerful awareness, satisfied with the mere fullness of being, the state of the power-holder is set aside by its own full power alone.

tokens.grounds: compound: bhāva + nirbharatā + mātra + saṃtṛpta; locative describing bodhabhairave/śaktiśālini
nija + śaktyā + eva; sandhi in text

label: AgMsv_1.44
cite_parts:
tādṛg eva vimarśātmā jñānadhārā vijṛmbhate /
yasyāṃ bhogopadeśena ko 'pi hlādaḥ pravartate // [AgMsv_1.44]
quick_english: Such a stream of knowledge, whose nature is reflective awareness, unfolds; and in it some delight arises through the teaching of enjoyment.

label: AgMsv_1.45
cite_parts:
yadīyasaṃvidācāracaryāvisrambhabhāvitaḥ /
bhogavrāto 'pi dhanyānāṃ niḥśreyasapadāyate // [AgMsv_1.45]
quick_english: For the fortunate, even the multitude of enjoyments, nourished by confidence in the practice of that awareness, becomes a state of supreme liberation.

tokens.grounds: compound: yadīya + saṃvid + ācāra + caryā + visrambha + bhāvita; describes bhogavrātaḥ

label: AgMsv_1.46
cite_parts:
yatrocyate svaśaktyādikṣobhasaṃraṃbhanirbharā /
devasya yāgapriyatā viśeṣān mātṛmadhyataḥ // [AgMsv_1.46]
quick_english: Here it is said that the deity's delight in worship is full of the stirring arousal of its own primordial power, especially arising from among the Mothers.

tokens.grounds: compound: sva + śakti + ādi + kṣobha + saṃraṃbha + nirbhara; describes yāgapriyatā
compound: yāga + priyatā; subject of cited statement

label: AgMsv_1.47
cite_parts:
aiśvaryaśaktyudrekeṇa labdheśvarapadābhidhaḥ /
devo vijñānamahimā prodbhūto 'yaṃ prapañcitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.47]
quick_english: By the surge of sovereign power, this deity, whose greatness is cognition and who has obtained the name of the lordly state, has become manifested and unfolded.

tokens.grounds: compound: aiśvarya + śakti + udreka; instrumental of cause
compound: labdha + īśvara + pada + abhidhā; describes devaḥ

label: AgMsv_1.48
cite_parts:
atrāpy anantabhāvāṃśasaṃyojanaviyojane /
prāgdaśābhedasaṃdhānād asaṃkhyatvam upāśrite // [AgMsv_1.48]
quick_english: Here too, in the joining and separating of infinite portions of beings, countlessness is attained because of the connection with the non-difference of the prior state.

tokens.grounds: compound: ananta + bhāva + aṃśa + saṃyojana + viyojana; locative dual/topic
compound: prāk + daśā + abheda + saṃdhāna; ablative of cause
locative/participial form expressing attainment; contextually predicate

label: AgMsv_1.49
cite_parts:
tadupādhivaśād eva saṃvijjñānapadojjhitāḥ /
tāyante vividhāḥ śāstrakriyājñānavibhūtayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.49]
quick_english: Simply by force of that adjunct, devoid of the state of consciousness-knowledge, are spread the various powers of scripture, action, and knowledge.

tokens.grounds: upādhi with vaśa ablative plus eva
ujjhita devoid with saṃvijjñānapada adj m.nom.pl
vibhūti with the triple compound f.nom.pl

label: AgMsv_1.50
cite_parts:
mukhyas tv eṣa prapañco 'yaṃ pañcātmatvena carcitaḥ /
tathā ca vakṣyate tattvam abhinnam api pañcadhā // [AgMsv_1.50]
quick_english: This main world is discussed as fivefold, yet the truth remains undivided.

label: AgMsv_1.51
cite_parts:
savyāpārādhipatvena taddhīnaprerakatvataḥ /
icchānivṛtteḥ svasthatvād ityādyair vākyasaṃcayaiḥ // [AgMsv_1.51]
quick_english: By active lordship, directing what lacks, desire cessation, and self-abiding, such sentence collections establish the point.

label: AgMsv_1.52
cite_parts:
nanv etāvati sandarbhe deśakālakalākṛtāḥ /
bhedā na saṃbhavanty eva bāḍham om iti vacmahe // [AgMsv_1.52]
quick_english: In this context, differences made by place, time, and art do not arise; granted, we say so.

label: AgMsv_1.53
cite_parts:
na hy atra kālatattvasya nāmamātraṃ vibhāvyate /
vaibhavy api mahākālī śaktir nātra vijṛmbhate // [AgMsv_1.53]
quick_english: Here time principle is not merely a name, and even great time power does not expand.

label: AgMsv_1.54
cite_parts:
tarhy abhinne svasaṃpūrṇe tadā paścāt punar yadā /
parataś ceti ko nv eṣa vācoyuktiparigrahaḥ // [AgMsv_1.54]
quick_english: Then, in the undivided self-full state, what is this grasp of speech reasoning?

label: AgMsv_1.55
cite_parts:
atra brūmaḥ satyam eva vastutas tu sphuṭātmani /
jṛmbhite tattvasarge 'pi kāle 'py unmiṣitātmani // [AgMsv_1.55]
quick_english: Here we say truth indeed; in reality, in clear self, even in expanded principle creation and time.

label: AgMsv_1.56
cite_parts:
bodhasya naiva santy etāḥ pūrvāparavikalpanāḥ /
kālo viśeṣaṇatvena yasmād bhavati bhedakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.56]
quick_english: For awareness, these prior and later alternatives do not exist, because time becomes a differentiator only as qualifier.

label: AgMsv_1.57
cite_parts:
viśeṣaṇaṃ ca tat proktaṃ samaśīrṣikayaiva yat /
bhedena vedyatām eti yathā nīlaṃ saroruhaṃ // [AgMsv_1.57]
quick_english: That qualifier is said to become knowability by difference, as a blue lotus.

label: AgMsv_1.58
cite_parts:
na ca bodhasya vedyatvaṃ kadācid upapadyate /
vedyatvaṃ bhāsamānatvaṃ tat prakāśaprasādataḥ // [AgMsv_1.58]
quick_english: Awareness is never knowable; knowability is appearing-ness by clarity grace.

label: AgMsv_1.59
cite_parts:
prakāśaḥ sa sa bodhaś ca na ced bodhāntarasthiteḥ /
prakāśaniyamān nūnam anavasthā pravartate // [AgMsv_1.59]
quick_english: Clarity is that awareness; if another awareness stood, surely regress would proceed from clarity rules.

label: AgMsv_1.60
cite_parts:
ata eva vimūḍhā ye bodham aprathamānakam /
arthaprathātmakaṃ brūyuḥ svavacovañcitās tu te // [AgMsv_1.60]
quick_english: Deluded ones who call awareness non-first-appearing and object-appearance-natured are cheated by their own words.

label: AgMsv_1.61
cite_parts:
tasmāt kālo na bodhasya bhedakatvāya kalpate /
nāpi vedyasya kālo 'sau bhedakībhavituṃ kṣamaḥ // [AgMsv_1.61]
quick_english: Therefore time is not fit to differentiate awareness, nor is that time able to become differentiator of the knowable.

label: AgMsv_1.62
cite_parts:
viśvaṃ hi bodhābhinnaṃ tad atathātve na bhāsate /
prakāśena samāviṣṭaś citraṃ bhāvaḥ prakāśate // [AgMsv_1.62]
quick_english: The universe is not different from awareness; otherwise it would not shine; pervaded by clarity, variegated being shines.

label: AgMsv_1.63
cite_parts:
viśvaprakāśa evaṃ syāt sarvasyaiva sadātanaḥ /
sati prakāśe bodhākhye sa prakāśatvam aśnute // [AgMsv_1.63]
quick_english: Thus universe clarity would be eternal for all; when clarity named awareness is present, it attains clarity-ness.

label: AgMsv_1.64
cite_parts:
aprakāśo 'pi bhāvaś cet prakāśātmā sa vedyate /
aprakāśas tv asau bhāva ity atra śaraṇaṃ tamaḥ // [AgMsv_1.64]
quick_english: Even if an unlit being is clarity-self and known, that unlit being is darkness as refuge here.

label: AgMsv_1.65
cite_parts:
yaś cāprakāśo bhāvātmā prakāśātmā sa cet kṛtaḥ /
nūnaṃ sa bhāvo naṣṭaḥ syāt svāprakāśatvavicyuteḥ // [AgMsv_1.65]
quick_english: If an unlit being-self is made clarity-self, surely that being would be destroyed from loss of self-clarity.

label: AgMsv_1.66
cite_parts:
nātadrūpaṃ prakāśaṃ ca kartuṃ vidhir api kṣamaḥ /
nanv etāvad idaṃbhāvaḥ prakāśe sati bhāsate // [AgMsv_1.66]
quick_english: Even rule cannot make clarity not of that form; but this being shines when clarity is present.

label: AgMsv_1.67
cite_parts:
astv etad eva kiṃtv ittham aprakāśaḥ prakāśatām /
bhāvasya cāprakāśatve prakāśībhāvite sati // [AgMsv_1.67]
quick_english: Let this be indeed; but thus unlit clarity-ness, of being and in unlit-ness, when made clear and present.

label: AgMsv_1.68
cite_parts:
naivaṃ prakāśito bhāva iti vastusthitir bhavet /
tad alaṃ vyatiriktena prakāśena śivas tathā // [AgMsv_1.68]
quick_english: Thus a separately manifested entity is not the state of things; enough of separate light, for shiva is so.

label: AgMsv_1.69
cite_parts:
tasmāt prakāśa evāsau gīto yaḥ paramaḥ śivaḥ /
sa evācintyamahimā svātantryoddāmaghūrṇitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.69]
quick_english: Therefore that light is sung as supreme shiva, whose inconceivable glory is swayed by freedom.

label: AgMsv_1.70
cite_parts:
prakāśate tathā tais taiḥ svabhāvair acyutasthitiḥ /
nātra sarvatra sarvajñabhāvaḥ kaś cana śaṅkyate // [AgMsv_1.70]
quick_english: So it shines through those natures in unfailing state; here all-knowingness is not suspected everywhere.

label: AgMsv_1.71
cite_parts:
ahaṃ caitro ghaṭaṃ vedmi na paṭaṃ, veda taṃ tv ayaṃ. /
nāyaṃ vetti paṭaḥ, so 'haṃ jāne ghaṭapaṭāv iti // [AgMsv_1.71]
quick_english: I, Caitra, know the pot not the cloth; but this one knows that; this one does not know the cloth; I know both pot and cloth.

label: AgMsv_1.72
cite_parts:
vediṣyāmi na vā, pūrvam ajānāṃ naiva vā kva cit, /
krameṇa vedmi yugapad dvābhyām ubhayavarjitam. // [AgMsv_1.72]
quick_english: I will know or not; before, not knowing; not anywhere; gradually I know, simultaneously, devoid of both.

label: AgMsv_1.73
cite_parts:
sarvaṃ vedmi, na kiṃ cic ca jāne. naivāsmi kaś cana /
bhāvātmā, nanu naivāham. ahaṃ sarvaṃ ca sarvadā. // [AgMsv_1.73]
quick_english: I know all, yet I know nothing; I am not any entity-self; indeed not I; I am all always.

label: AgMsv_1.74
cite_parts:
sarvam asmy aham evaikaḥ kiṃ sarvam itarad bhavet /
ityādir eka evāyaṃ prakāśaḥ pravijṛmbhate // [AgMsv_1.74]
quick_english: All am I alone; what else could all be? Thus one light unfolds.

label: AgMsv_1.75
cite_parts:
nanv eko yady asaḥ kaś cit, prakāśo na tadā paraḥ /
kathaṃ bhaved. aho mūḍhaḥ kathaṃ vyutpādyatām ayam // [AgMsv_1.75]
quick_english: If one were nonexistent, light would not then be supreme; how could it be? Alas fool, how is this to be instructed?

label: AgMsv_1.76
cite_parts:
ekaḥ prakāśaḥ svātantryāc citrarūpaḥ prakāśate. /
vastutaś ca na citro 'sau, nācitro bhedadūṣaṇāt // [AgMsv_1.76]
quick_english: One light shines in varied form from freedom; in reality it is neither varied nor unvaried, because of the fault of difference.

label: AgMsv_1.77
cite_parts:
ghaṭaprakāśe vastrasya prakāśo yadi saṃbhavet /
nāsau ghaṭaprakāśaḥ syād dviprakāśo hy asau bhavet // [AgMsv_1.77]
quick_english: If cloth's light arose in pot's light, that would not be pot-light; it would be two lights.

label: AgMsv_1.78
cite_parts:
so 'pi cāstv eva, no nāsti tad idaṃ tvatpracoditam /
ghaṭātmanā prakāśo 'sya mā bhūd ity avatiṣṭhate // [AgMsv_1.78]
quick_english: Let that be or not; this is urged by you; light should not be as pot-self, so it stands.

label: AgMsv_1.79
cite_parts:
tac cāyuktaṃ prakāśasya bodhatvāt svātmajṛmbhaṇam /
lakṣaṇaṃ yadi tat ko 'yaṃ vṛthā vāgjālaḍambaraḥ // [AgMsv_1.79]
quick_english: That is improper, since light's cognition-nature is self-unfolding; if that is the definition, what is this vain word-net pomp?

label: AgMsv_1.80
cite_parts:
paricchinnaprakāśatvaṃ jaḍasya kila lakṣaṇam /
jaḍād vilakṣaṇo bodho yato na parimīyate // [AgMsv_1.80]
quick_english: Limited light is the definition of inert; cognition is distinct from inert, because it is not measured.

label: AgMsv_1.81
cite_parts:
tasmād arkasya sadbhāve siddhe kaḥ khalu bāliśaḥ /
brūyāt katham ayaṃ svāṃśuśubhritāśeṣabhūr iti // [AgMsv_1.81]
quick_english: Therefore, since the sun's existence is established, what fool would say how this all-earth-bearing ray is?

label: AgMsv_1.82
cite_parts:
tasmāt siddhe prakāśe 'smin yāḥ prakāśavikalpanāḥ /
sarvās tāḥ sarvasaṃbhuktayoṣiccāritrapālanāḥ // [AgMsv_1.82]
quick_english: Therefore, since light is established, all its variations are keepers of all enjoyment and conduct.

label: AgMsv_1.83
cite_parts:
asiddhau ca prakāśasya ko 'haṃ kiṃ tvaṃ tamo 'pi kim /
na kiṃ cid api vā kiṃ syāt tūṣṇīṃ syād api vā katham // [AgMsv_1.83]
quick_english: If light were unestablished, who am I, what are you, what darkness? Nothing at all, or silence, or how?

label: AgMsv_1.84
cite_parts:
tasmāt prakāśatādātmyalabdhabhairavabhāginām /
bhāvānām api kālo 'yaṃ na kiṃ cit kartum arhati // [AgMsv_1.84]
quick_english: Therefore time cannot do anything to beings who share bhairava's light-identity.

label: AgMsv_1.85
cite_parts:
hanta tarhi kathaṃkāraṃ tadetyādivacaḥkramaḥ /
śrūyatām uktam apy etat punar nirbhajya bhaṇyate // [AgMsv_1.85]
quick_english: Alas, then how is the sequence of words like 'tad eti' made? Let it be heard; what was said is spoken again after separation.

tokens.quick_gloss: sequence of words like tad eti

label: AgMsv_1.86
cite_parts:
yaḥ prakāśaḥ sa evāyaṃ pratibhāti tathā tathā /
naiva cānyasya kasyāpi sa tu bhāty eva kevalam // [AgMsv_1.86]
quick_english: The light that is this very one appears thus and thus; no other's light shines, but that alone shines.

label: AgMsv_1.87
cite_parts:
sa eva paramodāraḥ sarvasyaivāvabhāsakaḥ /
svatantra iti tasyecchāśaktiḥ svātantryasaṃjñitā // [AgMsv_1.87]
quick_english: That very one is supremely generous and illuminator of all; being free, his will-power is called freedom.

label: AgMsv_1.88
cite_parts:
sa ca svātmani viśrāntas tadanyābhāvayogataḥ /
svātmaviśrāntir evaiṣā devasyānanda ucyate // [AgMsv_1.88]
quick_english: Resting in self through absence of other, that very rest in self is called the god's bliss.

label: AgMsv_1.89
cite_parts:
svātantryamahimaivāsya svarūpād apṛthaksthitiḥ /
svaprakāśe nije dhāmni bhāsayed bhāvavibhramān // [AgMsv_1.89]
quick_english: The greatness of his freedom, non-separate from own form, would illuminate confusions of beings in his own light-abode.

label: AgMsv_1.90
cite_parts:
bhāsanā ca kriyāśaktir iti śāstreṣu kathyate /
yayā vicitratattvādikalanā pravibhajyate // [AgMsv_1.90]
quick_english: Illumination is called the power of action in scriptures, by which manifold principle-creation is divided.

label: AgMsv_1.91
cite_parts:
bhāsanānavabhāte ca kathaṃ nāma prakalpate /
tad asyāntaḥsthitaṃ bhānaṃ jñānaśaktir ahaṃ smṛtā // [AgMsv_1.91]
quick_english: When illumination does not shine, how is anything conceived? That knowing situated within it is remembered as knowledge-power.

label: AgMsv_1.92
cite_parts:
etāvad asya devasya yad rūpaṃ svātmamātrataḥ /
sa unmeṣa iti proktaḥ pañcaśaktis tato vibhuḥ // [AgMsv_1.92]
quick_english: This much is the god's form from self alone; that is called opening, then five powers, then the all-pervading.

label: AgMsv_1.93
cite_parts:
triśaktir ekaśaktir vā devo vā kevalaḥ sthitaḥ /
śaktir evātha devī sā sāraśāstre nirūpyate // [AgMsv_1.93]
quick_english: Whether as three powers, one power, or god alone standing, that power then is the goddess determined in essence-scripture.

label: AgMsv_1.94
cite_parts:
vakṣyate ca jagaddhātuḥ kathitetyāditaḥ param /
saivaikā saty anekatvaṃ gacchatīti maheśinā // [AgMsv_1.94]
quick_english: The world-substance will be said from 'said' onward as supreme; that one alone, being, goes to manyness, says the great lord.

label: AgMsv_1.95
cite_parts:
sa cāyaṃ nirbharānandaviśrāntisvātmasusthitaḥ /
sodaryaiḥ śabdasaṃdarbhair bhāṣyate bhairavādibhiḥ // [AgMsv_1.95]
quick_english: This one, firmly bliss-rested in self, is described by sisterly word-arrangements by bhairava and others.

label: AgMsv_1.96
cite_parts:
savidhaṃ dūragaṃ vāpi yady apy asya na vastutaḥ /
śabdajātaṃ bhavet kiṃ cid anyad apy atha vā prabhoḥ // [AgMsv_1.96]
quick_english: Whether near or far-going, in reality nothing of this is other; what word-collection could there be, or anything else, of the lord?

label: AgMsv_1.97
cite_parts:
tathā ca bhāsayaty eva deva eṣa tathā tathā /
tatas tadanusāreṇa sarvo 'yaṃ kalpanākramaḥ // [AgMsv_1.97]
quick_english: Thus the god illuminates thus and thus; then according to that, all this sequence of construction follows.

label: AgMsv_1.98
cite_parts:
na ca tat kalpanāmātraṃ tathātve 'py atha kā kṣitiḥ /
tathā saṃkalpatāṃ devo yad vā kalpayatāṃ tathā // [AgMsv_1.98]
quick_english: Nor is that mere construction in such a state; then what ground? Thus the god's intentionality, or thus of those constructing.

label: AgMsv_1.99
cite_parts:
evaṃ caiṣa prakāśātmā saptatriṃśātmakāt paraḥ /
vaicitryabhāsanāṃ kurvan kālaṃ bhāsayati prabhuḥ // [AgMsv_1.99]
quick_english: Thus this light-self, beyond the thirty-seven-fold, doing manifold illumination, the lord illuminates time.

label: AgMsv_1.100
cite_parts:
vaicitryabhāsanaiveyaṃ kālaśaktir udāhṛtā /
tato 'vabhāsamānaitatkālaśaktyanurodhataḥ // [AgMsv_1.100]
quick_english: This very manifold illumination is declared as time-power; then according to the shining time-power.

label: AgMsv_1.101
cite_parts:
āsmākīnāt tadetyādir uparāgaḥ pravartate /
na cāsau tatra nāsty eva tatra yan nāsti tat kutaḥ // [AgMsv_1.101]
quick_english: From ours the coloring 'tad eti' and so on proceeds; that is not there; indeed what is not there, whence is that?

label: AgMsv_1.102
cite_parts:
anyatra tanyatāṃ nāma tat prakāśavaśaṃ sthitam /
nanv evam apare tattvajāle śuddhetarasthitau // [AgMsv_1.102]
quick_english: Let it be elsewhere; that stands under light's control. Indeed thus others are in the net of principles in pure-impure state.

label: AgMsv_1.103
cite_parts:
śuddhāśuddhapade vāpi vidyādau tattvamaṇḍale /
śuddhabhairavasadbhāvād aviśeṣo bhaviṣyati // [AgMsv_1.103]
quick_english: In the circle of principles, pure Bhairava existence makes no distinction remain.

label: AgMsv_1.104
cite_parts:
narīnṛtyāmahe hanta yatnād vyākhyeyam eva naḥ /
āyuṣmato yad dhṛdaye svayaṃ viparivartate // [AgMsv_1.104]
quick_english: We dance, alas; the teaching must be explained with effort, since it turns in the heart of the long-lived one.

label: AgMsv_1.105
cite_parts:
śuddhāśuddhavibhedo hi paramārthakathāsu no /
sa tu tatkṛta evāste mūḍhānāṃ dhiyi niścalaḥ // [AgMsv_1.105]
quick_english: In ultimate speech there is no pure-impure distinction; yet that distinction remains fixed in fools' minds.

label: AgMsv_1.106
cite_parts:
nanu śuddhetaratvākhyo yadi bhedo na vāstavaḥ /
vyācikīrṣitam evaitac chāstraṃ vivadate tataḥ // [AgMsv_1.106]
quick_english: If the pure-otherness difference is unreal, then scripture disputes only the intended apparent distinction.

label: AgMsv_1.107
cite_parts:
aśuddhatvaṃ hi tattvānāṃ dīkṣayā śodhanaṃ tataḥ /
ityādi bahudhā bhedapradhānātra yataḥ sthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.107]
quick_english: Impurity of principles is purified by initiation; hence difference-dominant positions are only local.

label: AgMsv_1.108
cite_parts:
ucyate nādvaye 'muṣmin dvaitaṃ nāsty eva sarvathā /
uktaṃ hi bhedavandhye 'pi vibhau bhedāvabhāsanam // [AgMsv_1.108]
quick_english: In the nondual there is no duality at all; yet difference appears even in the all-pervading.

label: AgMsv_1.109
cite_parts:
tad eva khalu saṃsāre māyāvidyādibhiḥ padaiḥ /
bandha ity ucyate tatra rūḍhāḥ saṃsāriṇo matāḥ // [AgMsv_1.109]
quick_english: That is truly called bondage in samsara by maya, knowledge, and related terms; worldly beings are established as such.

label: AgMsv_1.110
cite_parts:
taccintānusṛter eṣāṃ śuddhāśuddhādiniścayaḥ /
kiṃ ca śāstram idaṃ samyag bhagavadyogadeśakam // [AgMsv_1.110]
quick_english: Following that thought gives these beings certainty of pure and impure; and this scripture properly teaches bhagavat yoga.

label: AgMsv_1.111
cite_parts:
bhagavadyogam advaitaṃ nirdvandvaṃ ca pracakṣate /
tasyopadeśa itthaṃ syād yadi yāvadvibhedavat // [AgMsv_1.111]
quick_english: They call bhagavat yoga nondual and free from pairs; its teaching would be thus if difference still appears.

label: AgMsv_1.112
cite_parts:
saṃbhāvyate tan nirbhajya nirbhajyaiva nirūpyate /
advaite bhairavavibhau yat praveśopaveśayoḥ // [AgMsv_1.112]
quick_english: That is imagined and determined by separating; in nondual Bhairava all-pervading, entry and seating are considered.

label: AgMsv_1.113
cite_parts:
ābhyāsikī sthitir nāsti tau hi bhedaikajīvitau /
ataḥ saṃbhāvyanikhiladvaitaśaṅkāvyapohane // [AgMsv_1.113]
quick_english: Habitual position is absent, for those two live by difference alone; therefore doubt of universal nonduality is removed.

label: AgMsv_1.114
cite_parts:
gurūṇāṃ ca śiśūnāṃ ca yatnaḥ sarvo vijṛmbhate /
ato dvaitam ihāśaṅkyāśaṅkya sarvaṃ pratanyate // [AgMsv_1.114]
quick_english: All effort unfolds for teachers and children; therefore duality is spread here by doubting and not doubting.

label: AgMsv_1.115
cite_parts:
tad yāvadgati saṃbhāvya na tu kutrāpy udāsyate /
tathā hi yadi nāmṛṣṭaṃ dvaitaṃ tarhy ekam eva sat // [AgMsv_1.115]
quick_english: That is imagined as far as going, not neglected anywhere; if duality is unrefuted, then one being alone remains.

label: AgMsv_1.116
cite_parts:
cidbrahma tad alaṃ tattvasaṃkhyākalpananirṇayaiḥ /
pañcatriṃśatitā kasmāt tattvānāṃ tan nirūpyate // [AgMsv_1.116]
quick_english: Consciousness-Brahman is enough; why is the thirty-fiveness of principles determined?

label: AgMsv_1.117
cite_parts:
tasmād dvaitasya bhedātmasthiter yāvadgati graham /
kṛtvā yas tatpratikṣepas tena niḥśaṅkatā bhavet // [AgMsv_1.117]
quick_english: Therefore, having grasped duality's difference-nature as far as it goes, one who rejects it becomes fearless.

label: AgMsv_1.118
cite_parts:
etad eva ca vijñāne nirbhidyaivopadeśanam /
yathāsaṃbhavi yad vajrapakṣāṇāṃ tad vidāraṇam // [AgMsv_1.118]
quick_english: This indeed is teaching pierced in knowledge; as possible, it tears the diamond wings.

label: AgMsv_1.119
cite_parts:
tathā hi śrīmatā stotre bhaṭṭanārāyaṇena tat /
namas te bhavasaṃbhrāntabhrāntim udbhāvya bhindate // [AgMsv_1.119]
quick_english: Thus in the glorious hymn by Bhatta Narayana, salutation to you manifests and breaks worldly delusion.

label: AgMsv_1.120
cite_parts:
jñānānandaṃ ca nirdvandvaṃ deva vṛtvā vivṛṇvate /
nirdvandvam iti nirdvaitaṃ prakaṭīkriyate padam // [AgMsv_1.120]
quick_english: They reveal knowledge-bliss free from pairs, O god; the word free-from-pairs is made manifest as nondual.

label: AgMsv_1.121
cite_parts:
udbhāvyante bhramāś ceti cakāro 'trādbhutāvahaḥ /
iha cādvaitam eveti purataḥ prataniṣyate // [AgMsv_1.121]
quick_english: Delusions are manifested, and the ca here is wonder-bringing; here nondual is spread before.

label: AgMsv_1.122
cite_parts:
adhvaśuddhyādikaṃ dvaite 'nupapattīti vakṣyate /
abhedena vinā naitan nanu bhedaṃ vināpi kim // [AgMsv_1.122]
quick_english: Path-purification and the like — its incongruence in dualism will be stated: not this without non-difference. But surely, what even without difference?

tokens.grounds: śuddhi with adhvan and ādi n.acc.sg
anupapatti with elided a plus iti

label: AgMsv_1.123
cite_parts:
satyaṃ kiṃtv advaye tattve bhedo 'pi na na yujyate /
idaṃ hi tat parādvaitaṃ bhedatyāgagrahau na yat // [AgMsv_1.123]
quick_english: True — but in the nondual principle even difference is not unfitting; for this is that supreme nondualism, which is no abandoning-and-grasping of difference.

label: AgMsv_1.124
cite_parts:
bhede tu viśvabhāvānāṃ svasvabhāvavyavasthiteḥ /
abheda iti śabdo 'yaṃ manye bhedayate rasāt // [AgMsv_1.124]
quick_english: But in difference, with world-beings settled each in its own nature — this word non-difference, I think, divides them out of sheer relish.

label: AgMsv_1.125
cite_parts:
tad alaṃ prakṛtaṃ nirūpyate parameśaḥ kila bhedakalpanām /
prakaṭīkurute yathā tathā nanu kālo 'pi vijṛmbhate tathā // [AgMsv_1.125]
quick_english: Enough of that — the matter at hand is answered: as the Lord indeed manifests the imagining of difference, so too surely does time expand likewise.

label: AgMsv_1.127
cite_parts:
na tathāpi ca yāti bhinnatāṃ
paramārthena kadācid eva saḥ /
yugapat sa hi saṃvidātmakaḥ

nanv ittham ekaghanabhāvavimarśasār saṃvedane yad aham eṣa karomi citraḥ /
jānāmi vā tad apare 'pi na maitracaitraprāyā vidadhyur athavāpi kathaṃ na vidyuḥ // [AgMsv_1.127]
quick_english: Yet even so he never at any time attains separateness in the ultimate sense — for he is all-at-once, of the nature of consciousness. But surely — O essence of densely packed being-awareness — in awareness, that what I do here is strange, or that I know: would not others too, ordinary Mitras and Caitras, do the same? Or how would they not know?

label: AgMsv_1.128
cite_parts:
aho māyāgranthir nibiḍatama eṣo 'tra bhavatām idaṃ hi prabrūmaḥ svaparam iha nāsty ekam abhidam /
ahaṃ vedmīty eṣā ghaṭatanuviśeṣaprakaṭatā prathāś citrākārāḥ paramahasi bhāntīti kathitam // [AgMsv_1.128]
quick_english: 'Ah! Here, good sirs, is the very dense knot of māyā. This we declare: here there is neither own nor other, one undivided. 'I know' — that is but the manifestation of a pot-particular; manifold variegated forth-arisings shine in the supreme, thus it is told.

tokens.grounds: granthi with māyā visarga to r

label: AgMsv_1.129
cite_parts:
tasmād ghaṭaṃ vedmy aham ity amutra bhedo na kaścin nanu me ghaṭo 'yam /
bhātīti bhedapratibhānam asti naitan na tasyaiṣa śivas tathāyam // [AgMsv_1.129]
quick_english: Therefore in 'I know the pot' there is no difference at all. But surely — 'this pot appears to me' — difference does manifest! Not so — for him this very pot is Śiva, just so.

label: AgMsv_1.130
cite_parts:
ata eva dvaipāyanamukhyās teṣu svaśāstradeśeṣu /
mamakāram eva mṛtyuṃ khaṇḍanadāyitvataḥ prāhuḥ // [AgMsv_1.130]
quick_english: Therefore those headed by Dvaipāyana declared in their own scriptural domains that mine-making itself is death — by way of giving refutation.

label: AgMsv_1.131
cite_parts:
tad evaṃ kālakalanopādhijātoparāgajāḥ /
tadetyādi pratāyante paratattve 'pi saṃvidaḥ // [AgMsv_1.131]
quick_english: Thus, born of the coloring produced by the time-reckoning adjunct, set forth beginning with 'that' — consciousnesses, even in the supreme principle.

tokens.grounds: jāta born with the long compound adj m.nom.pl

label: AgMsv_1.132
cite_parts:
tatra pūrṇaikarūpatvāt sarvaṃ sarvatra cāpi tat /
anyathā khaṇḍanāyogān na pūrṇā pūrṇatā bhavet // [AgMsv_1.132]
quick_english: Therein, from being of full one nature, all is everywhere too — for otherwise, division being inapplicable, fullness would not be full.

label: AgMsv_1.133
cite_parts:
tataḥ pūrṇatayā sarvaṃsahabhairavadhāmani /
pañcātmako 'yaṃ śāstrārthaḥ śāmbhavaḥ. śaktyaṇusthitim // [AgMsv_1.133]
quick_english: Thence, in fullness, in the abode of all-enduring Bhairava: this five-natured teaching-meaning is the Śāmbhavas — on the abiding of śakti and atom-soul.

tokens.grounds: sentence-period token relating to Śambhu predicate

label: AgMsv_1.134
cite_parts:
nyakkṛtyaiṣa parāṃ devīṃ svātmany udrecya vartate /
itthaṃ sa visisṛkṣuḥ san bhāvān visraṣṭṛtāpadāt // [AgMsv_1.134]
quick_english: Having established the supreme goddess, this one abides, surpassed in himself; thus, desirous of emitting beings, from the state of the emitter.

label: AgMsv_1.135
cite_parts:
pūrvam ucchalitānandaghanām abhajata sthitim /
visraṣṭṛtāpade tv eṣa visargāveśabhāg api // [AgMsv_1.135]
quick_english: Formerly he resorted to the surging-bliss-dense state; but in the emitter-state this one shares even in emission-absorption.

tokens.grounds: ghana dense with ucchalita-ānanda adj f.acc.sg

label: AgMsv_1.136
cite_parts:
riktībhaviṣyann ānandaghanayā pūrṇayā citā /
tāvad ānandaśaktyaṃśavisargāveśanirbharaḥ // [AgMsv_1.136]
quick_english: While about to become empty, he is still filled with the entry of bliss-power's partial emission.

label: AgMsv_1.137
cite_parts:
vartamānaḥ svaśaktyoghapūrṇaś cābhūd bhaviṣyati /
riktaśaktir iti tryātmacitrasaṃvedanātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.137]
quick_english: Present and full of his own power-flow, he became and will be power-depleted, as triple-self varied experience.

label: AgMsv_1.138
cite_parts:
tadāsau devadevaḥ syād visraṣṭari pade sphuṭam /
nanu kiṃ vartamānāṃśe saṃsto bhūtabhaviṣyatī // [AgMsv_1.138]
quick_english: Then he, god of gods, would clearly stand in the creator station; what stands in the present portion, past and future?

label: AgMsv_1.139
cite_parts:
kiṃ nāma bhavatā jñātaṃ te svatantre 'pi ke cana /
vartamānāvadher bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyac ca vibhajyate // [AgMsv_1.139]
quick_english: What indeed is known by you? Even in independence, can past and future be divided by a present boundary?

label: AgMsv_1.140
cite_parts:
yac ca yatra na viśrāntaṃ tad vibhajyeta vai kutaḥ /
kathaṃ cāvadhibhāvaḥ syād vartamānasya te prati // [AgMsv_1.140]
quick_english: That which has not rested where cannot be divided; whence and how could a boundary state of the present be toward you?

label: AgMsv_1.141
cite_parts:
tayor avadhimattvaṃ vā tat praty api kathaṃ bhavet /
viśvasya viśvam avadhis tadvad vā jāyate na kim // [AgMsv_1.141]
quick_english: How could boundedness of those two be, even toward that? Is the universe a boundary, or does it arise similarly? Not what?

label: AgMsv_1.142
cite_parts:
tasmād bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyac ca vartamānākhyasaṃvidi /
rūḍham eveti tatraiva yadi viśrāntim āvahet // [AgMsv_1.142]
quick_english: Therefore past and future are rooted in present-named consciousness; if one brings rest there only.

label: AgMsv_1.143
cite_parts:
yadi cātraiva nikhilakalpanāraśmimaṇḍalam /
avisphārya kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhet saṃniruddhanijasthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.143]
quick_english: If here only the whole array of conceptual rays is not expanded, for a moment one would stand with restrained own state.

label: AgMsv_1.144
cite_parts:
tan nijāmṛtavisphāracamatkāraikacarvaṇām /
labhate paramānandasudhāsandohavāhinīm // [AgMsv_1.144]
quick_english: That obtains a single tasting of own nectar-expansion wonder, carrying supreme bliss-nectar abundance.

label: AgMsv_1.145
cite_parts:
tathā hi sūryaraśmyoghapūrṇaḥ syāc candramā yadā /
tadā sūryakarān bhūyo yāvan na visisṛkṣati // [AgMsv_1.145]
quick_english: Thus indeed the moon would be full of sun-ray union; when then it does not again wish to emit sun-rays.

label: AgMsv_1.146
cite_parts:
tāvat svamaṇḍalābhoge kṣaṇaṃ viśrāntisusthitaḥ /
antaḥsthaviśvadevāṃśatarpaṇāpātram ucyate // [AgMsv_1.146]
quick_english: So long, resting well in enjoyment of its own orb for a moment, it is called a vessel for satisfying portions of inner world-gods.

label: AgMsv_1.147
cite_parts:
evaṃ bhāvaprakāśārkamarīcinicayāñcite /
svabodhacandramahasi vartamāne hṛdantare // [AgMsv_1.147]
quick_english: Thus, in the heart interior, the moon of own awareness is present, shone upon by the cluster of rays of the sun of being-light.

label: AgMsv_1.148
cite_parts:
viśrānto 'ntaḥsthitodāracitsudhāsārasundare /
antaḥsthasvāmṛtāpūro vamyate na bahir yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.148]
quick_english: Rested in the beautiful inner abundant nectar of consciousness, filled with inner own nectar, it is not vomited outside, because.

label: AgMsv_1.149
cite_parts:
tata evāntar evāsau ghūrṇamānaḥ samucchalan /
svāntaḥsthadevatācakratarpaṇāhaṃvidātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.149]
quick_english: From that, only inside, that one, revolving and rising, consists of I-awareness satisfying the inner wheel of gods.

label: AgMsv_1.150
cite_parts:
jāyate yāvad uddāmyet tāvat svakaraṇakramaḥ /
niruddhe raśmipaṭale vibhavābhāvayogataḥ // [AgMsv_1.150]
quick_english: As long as it is raised, so long the own sense-process arises, while restrained in the ray-sheet by union of prosperity and absence.

label: AgMsv_1.151
cite_parts:
na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyac ca vartamānād vibhajyate /
avibhāgas tayor yāvat tāvat kā vartamānatā // [AgMsv_1.151]
quick_english: Past and future are not divided from the present; as long as there is non-division of those two, what is present-ness?
